device_id.description: Unique identifier for the edge gateway or sensor node

timestamp.description: NTP-synced timestamp of when the reading was taken

switching_state_bdc1.description: Is metal currently detected? (Binary Data Channel 1)

counter_value.description: Internal hardware stroke counter (total lifetime pulses)

device_temperature_c.description: Internal chip temperature of the inductive sensor

operating_hours.description: Total hours the sensor has been powered on

signal_quality.description: 0 to 255 indicator of sensor alignment and cleanliness

strokes_in_interval.description: Edge-computed number of machine cycles in the last polling interval

last_cycle_time_seconds.description: Time elapsed between the last two falling edges of the pulse
